methodology_notes: All base-model fitting and meta-classifier training occurred inside each outer training fold.
The outer held-out fold was not used for model fitting or threshold selection.
The evaluation pool is the official training split only.
The official validation and test splits were not included in this nested cross-validation.
Isolation Forest anomaly scores are inputs to the meta-model; they are not standalone malware probabilities.
The fixed 0.50 threshold was used for primary outer-fold evaluation.
